sections.subhead: Know Exactly What Stock You Have, Where It Is, and When It's Running Low

body.text: Teknoppy builds custom inventory management software in Kochi that tracks stock across shops and warehouses in real time, with barcode scanning, reorder alerts and links to your billing or online store. Most projects go live in 4-8 weeks.

Stockouts lose sales, and overstocking ties up valuable working capital. Choosing the right Inventory Management Software Company in Kochi ensures your inventory records match the physical shelves exactly. Unlike off-the-shelf software with monthly subscription tiers and SKU caps, our custom software gives you unlimited items, tailored barcode scanning, and 100% code ownership.

sections.h2: What Our Custom Inventory Management Software Includes

items.title: Multi-Warehouse & Branch Stock Visibility
items.html: Track inventory across central godowns, retail branches, and transit vehicles in real time. Manage inter-branch stock transfer orders (STO), gate passes, and delivery challans seamlessly.

items.title: Barcode & Mobile QR Code Scanning
items.html: Accelerate stock intake, picking, and periodic stock audits using smartphone cameras or industrial handheld Bluetooth/USB scanners, reducing manual counting errors.

items.title: Batch, Lot & Expiry Tracking
items.html: Enforce First-In-First-Out (FIFO) or First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) picking for pharmaceutical, chemical, and FMCG distributors, with automated early warning alerts for near-expiry batches.

items.title: Serial Number & Warranty Tracking
items.html: Track individual high-value items, electronics, and machinery by unique serial numbers from purchase to dispatch and warranty claim history.

items.title: Automated Reorder Alerts & PO Generation
items.html: Prevent stockouts with dynamic safety stock thresholds. Generate automated purchase orders (PO) and vendor alerts when stock dips below reorder points.

items.title: GST Billing, Tally & Ecommerce Integration
items.html: Synchronize inventory data directly with Tally Prime, custom billing systems, or ecommerce storefronts via our API Integration Services. For full business operations, explore our ERP Development.

sections.h2: Custom Inventory Software or Zoho Inventory / Tally?

items.title: Off-the-Shelf Tools (Zoho Inventory, Basic Tally)
items.text: Off-the-shelf tools work well for simple retail setups. However, monthly subscriptions increase steeply as order volumes and warehouse locations multiply. Complex barcode scanning, custom serial number tracking, and multi-bin warehouse workflows often require awkward workarounds.

items.title: Teknoppy Custom Inventory Software
items.text: Custom inventory software delivers a tailored interface built around your actual receiving and dispatch workflows. You get unlimited SKUs, zero monthly per-user licensing fees, direct two-way sync with Tally and GST billing, and complete database control.

items.title: 1. Warehouse & Stock Flow Audit
items.text: We analyze your physical storage layout, receiving routines, picking cycles, and dispatch bottlenecks before writing code.

items.title: 2. Barcode & SKU Hierarchy Architecture
items.text: We structure your category trees, units of measure (UOM), barcode formats (EAN/QR), and reorder logic.

items.title: 3. Custom Build & Integration
items.text: We build the desktop inventory hub and mobile barcode scanning interfaces, connecting your billing and accounting tools.

items.title: 4. Stock Data Migration & Audit Reconciliation
items.text: We import existing SKU catalogs and assist your warehouse staff in conducting a baseline physical stock audit to ensure zero variance.

items.title: 5. Warehouse Floor Training & Go-Live
items.text: Hands-on training for floor supervisors, dispatch clerks, and billing operators ensures rapid adoption.

sections.h2: Who Needs Custom Inventory Management Software

items.html: Wholesale Distributors & Stockists: Managing thousands of fast-moving SKUs across multiple Kerala depots with automated dispatch challans and GST invoices.
Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Distributors: Requiring mandatory batch tracking, manufacturing/expiry date tracking, and drug license compliance.
Multi-Channel Retailers & Ecommerce: Synchronizing physical retail store inventory with online orders across WooCommerce and custom web stores.
Manufacturers & Assembly Units: Tracking raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods alongside real-time stock dashboards via our Dashboard Development Services.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Inventory Management Software Kochi

items.q: How much does custom inventory management software cost in Kochi?
items.a: Custom inventory software typically costs ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 for single-location businesses (4–5 weeks), and ₹1,10,000 to ₹2,20,000+ for multi-warehouse distribution businesses with batch tracking and accounting integrations (6–8 weeks). You pay zero monthly subscription fees.

items.q: Can the inventory software integrate with Tally and Indian GST billing?
items.a: Yes. We build two-way integrations that automatically generate GST-compliant delivery challans and tax invoices, and synchronize stock vouchers directly with Tally Prime or legacy billing software.

items.q: Does it support batch numbers and expiry date tracking?
items.a: Yes. Our software includes comprehensive batch and lot tracking with automated First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) picking alerts, essential for pharmaceuticals, food distribution, and FMCG businesses.

items.q: Can our warehouse team use smartphone cameras for barcode scanning?
items.a: Yes. Warehouse clerks can scan barcodes and QR codes directly using the camera on standard Android or iOS smartphones, as well as dedicated Bluetooth/USB laser barcode scanners.

items.q: Can we track stock across multiple warehouses and retail stores?
items.a: Yes. Multi-location inventory management provides consolidated real-time stock counts across central warehouses, retail outlets, and transit vehicles, with complete audit logs for every stock transfer.

items.q: How is this different from the inventory features in an ERP system?
items.a: Our standalone inventory software is designed specifically for stock tracking, warehousing, and dispatch without the cost or complexity of a full ERP suite. If you also require integrated production planning and multi-department finance, our ERP Development services provide the complete solution.
